_comment: Hologram models (VECTOR's format: vector's tools/holo/collection.py and assets/holo/README.md). Boxes are [x0,x1, y0,y1, z0,z1] in fractions of the normalised bounding box (y up, front +z); a face goes to the first part whose box holds its centroid, else to the part with rest=true. bind names the live reading a part shows (VECTOR's holo/bind.py), empty for a part that only shapes the model. Sources are in src/; the baked NAME.holo.npz sit next to this file. Rebake: ~/.local/share/bromigos/venv/bin/python <vector>/tools/holo/bake.py --root THIS_DIR --preview

parts.label: ANTENNA MAST
parts.hint: The whip mast behind the dish: when anyone on any band calls out and nobody else hears, Juno is the first to answer

parts.label: LONG-RANGE DISH
parts.hint: The long-range dish Juno kept turning through ten years of unanswered calls into the blizzards. Lit while every channel on the network answers

parts.label: RELAY HUT
parts.hint: The relay hut, half-buried now. The flame is cut into its steel door: frost fills it white every night, and every morning it is scraped black again

parts.label: GLACIER
parts.hint: The glacier of a mining moon switched off in the Switch-Off. Ice-foxes den in the lee of the hut, and under the ice something colossal moves: the crews call them Frostbacks
